newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Miguel units show mixed H1 earnings. [CORRECTED 06:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: San Miguel units show mixed H1 earnings. [CORRECTED 06:00 GMT]

text.p: Two units of beverage and food firm San Miguel corp reported on Thursday mixed results for the first half.
(Corrects period throughout to first half from second quarter.)
Documents submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission showed San Miguel Properties Philippines Inc made a net income of 742.43 million pesos in the first half.
San Miguel Foods Inc reported a net loss of 46.77 million (corrects from 467.77 million) pesos in the first half on net sales of 3.86 billion pesos.
